items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares an agent-produced Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem solution
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI公布代理系統產出的Navier–Stokes千禧年問題解法
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a research note saying an internal next-generation model, more capable than GPT-6 Astra and run as about 10,000 coordinating agents, produced an analytical proof and Lean formalization that smooth 3D Navier–Stokes flow can form a finite-time singularity while energy stays finite. The lab says this establishes Clay statements C and D, will not claim the prize, and separately reports an unforced Euler blowup found earlier in the same run.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布研究說明：內部新一代模型（能力高於GPT-6 Astra）以約一萬個協同代理產出分析證明與Lean形式化，指出光滑三維Navier–Stokes流動可在有限時間形成奇異點且能量保持有限。實驗室稱這確立Clay表述C與D，不打算申領獎金，並另報同一輪次較早得到的無外力Euler爆破結果。
items_flat.analysis_en: If the Lean check holds under independent review, this is the first lab-scale claim that agents closed a Millennium Problem—and it is a blowup, not global regularity. Credit, force conditions, and whether Clay or the math community accept the writeup remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若Lean驗證經獨立審查成立，這是實驗室首次主張代理閉合千禧年問題——且是爆破而非全域正則性。優先權、外力條件，以及Clay與數學社群是否接受寫作，仍待確認。
items_flat.quote: We’re sharing a solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem… This proof, produced by an internal OpenAI system, shows that the dynamics of the Navier-Stokes equations for fluid motion can develop a singularity in finite time.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在分享Navier–Stokes存在與光滑性問題的一個解法……這份由內部OpenAI系統產出的證明顯示，描述流體運動的Navier–Stokes方程動力學可在有限時間內發展出奇異點。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral raises €3B Series D at €21B+ valuation, led by Samsung
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral完成三星領投的30億歐元D輪，估值逾210億歐元
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced a €3 billion Series D at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, which it called the largest equity round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after launch. Samsung Electronics led, with EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity as co-leads; Nvidia, ASML, a16z and others participated. Proceeds are slated for frontier research, owned compute and commercial expansion across 20 countries.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral宣布完成30億歐元D輪、投後估值逾210億歐元，並稱這是歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資，距創立僅三年。三星電子領投，EQT管理的Scaleup Europe Fund與PSG Equity共同領投；Nvidia、ASML、a16z等跟投。資金將用於前沿研究、自有算力與20國商業擴張。
items_flat.analysis_en: The round is a capital-and-sovereignty bet more than a model launch: chip suppliers now sit on both sides of Mistral’s cap table. Whether the money produces a competitive open-weight frontier model is still unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此輪更像資本與主權押注，而非模型發表：晶片供應商已同時站在Mistral股權兩側。資金能否換來具競爭力的開源權重前沿模型，仍未驗證。
items_flat.quote: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after the company's launch.
items_flat.quote_zh: Mistral今日宣布完成30億歐元D輪融資，投後估值逾210億歐元，為歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資，距公司創立僅三年。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind launches AlphaGenome Atlas covering all 9 billion possible human SNVs
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind推出涵蓋約90億個人類單核苷酸變異的AlphaGenome Atlas
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, a searchable roughly 1-petabyte catalogue of predicted molecular effects for every possible single-nucleotide variant in the human genome—about 9 billion changes. The resource adds an AlphaGenome Variant Impact score that combines AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense, and is free for academic use via a web portal, API and a Google Antigravity skill; commercial Cloud access is planned.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，約1 PB可搜尋目錄，涵蓋人類基因組所有可能單核苷酸變異（約90億處）的分子效應預測。資源新增結合AlphaGenome與AlphaMissense的AVI分數，學術用途可經入口網站、API與Google Antigravity skill免費使用；商業雲端存取規劃中。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is science infrastructure, not a consumer model: last year’s predictor becomes a genome-wide lookup table. Clinical use is not what the lab is authorizing today; independent validation will decide whether AVI scores enter diagnostics.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是科學基礎設施而非消費模型：去年的預測器變成全基因組查詢表。實驗室今日並未授權臨床使用；AVI分數能否進入診斷，取決於獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are introducing AlphaGenome Atlas: a platform containing predictions for the effects of 9 billion single-nucleotide variants — every single-letter change possible — in the human genome.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出AlphaGenome Atlas：一個平台，包含人類基因組中90億個單核苷酸變異——每一個可能的單字母改變——的效應預測。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI ships ChatGPT Images 2.5, Sketch, and GPT-Image-2.5 API models
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Images 2.5, saying it improves lighting, textures, reference-subject fidelity and multi-turn edits while cutting generation latency by up to 50% versus Images 2.0. ChatGPT adds Sketch (@Sketch doodles as references) and templates; the API adds GPT-Image-2.5 Flare for speed/quality and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst for detailed creative work. Help-center notes say existing image limits are unchanged and templates are not yet in Work mode.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI推出ChatGPT Images 2.5，稱在光照、紋理、參考主體保真與多輪編輯上提升，並較Images 2.0最多降低約50%生成延遲。ChatGPT新增Sketch（以塗鴉作參考）與模板；API新增偏速度品質的GPT-Image-2.5 Flare與偏精細創作的Sunburst。說明中心指出既有圖像額度不變，模板尚未進入Work模式。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an image-stack refresh, not a new text frontier. The practical change is faster iteration plus two named API variants whose quality gap versus rivals still needs independent evals.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是圖像堆疊更新，不是新的文字前沿。實質變化是更快迭代，以及兩個具名API變體；相對競品的品質差距仍待獨立評測。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT Images 2.5 is rolling out today to all ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, and Codex users across desktop, mobile, and web.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Images 2.5今日向所有ChatGPT、ChatGPT Work與Codex使用者在桌面、行動與網頁上推出。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra is fully rolled out in Codex and ChatGPT Work for paid tiers
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI稱GPT-6 Astra已在付費層的Codex與ChatGPT Work全面上線
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted that Astra is fully rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users in Codex and ChatGPT Work, pointing builders to a live demo on GPT-TV. Help-center language still treats general Chat access to Astra-powered GPT-6 as a separate surface from Work/Codex.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發文稱Astra已向Plus、Pro、Business與Enterprise使用者在Codex與ChatGPT Work全面上線，並指向GPT-TV上的即時演示。說明中心仍把一般Chat對Astra驅動GPT-6的存取，與Work/Codex視為不同產品面。
items_flat.analysis_en: Availability, not a new model: the split between Work/Codex and ordinary Chat is now the live product policy. How much Plus users can actually consume under existing allowances remains the operational question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是可用性更新而非新模型：Work/Codex與一般Chat的分流已成現行產品政策。Plus使用者在既有額度下實際能消耗多少，仍是營運問題。
items_flat.quote: Astra is fully rolled out to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in Codex and ChatGPT Work.
items_flat.quote_zh: Astra已向Plus、Pro、Business與Enterprise使用者在Codex與ChatGPT Work全面上線。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI becomes anchor customer for two Firmus AI factories in Malaysia
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI成為Firmus馬來西亞兩座AI工廠的錨定客戶
items_flat.summary_en: Nvidia-backed Australian operator Firmus said OpenAI signed a multi-year deal for dedicated compute at two Malaysia AI Factory sites, lifting Firmus’s contracted capacity above 900 MW across Australia, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia.
items_flat.summary_zh: 獲Nvidia支持的澳洲營運商Firmus表示，OpenAI簽署多年約，承租馬來西亞兩座AI工廠的專用算力，使Firmus在澳洲、新加坡、印尼與馬來西亞的簽約容量超過900 MW。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is capacity procurement, not a model launch. It extends OpenAI’s Asia-Pacific footprint while other campus projects face delay, but power, water and ready-for-service dates in Malaysia are not independently confirmed here.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產能採購而非模型發表。它擴大OpenAI亞太足跡，但馬來西亞場址的電力、用水與可服務日期此處未獲獨立確認。
items_flat.quote: We’re excited to work with Firmus as we expand our global compute capacity. These new data centers in Malaysia will help us serve growing demand for OpenAI’s products across the region and around the world.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們很高興與 Firmus 合作以擴大全球算力。這些馬來西亞新資料中心將協助我們服務區域與全球對 OpenAI 產品不斷成長的需求。

items_flat.title_en: Inception Labs releases Mercury 2.5 diffusion LLM at 1,107 tok/s
items_flat.title_zh: Inception Labs發布每秒1,107 token的擴散LLM Mercury 2.5
items_flat.summary_en: Inception Labs released Mercury 2.5, calling it its most capable production diffusion LLM and the largest such model it has trained. The company claims a 40% intelligence lift over Mercury 2, 1,107 tokens per second on widely available Nvidia GPUs, a 260K context window, and list pricing of $0.20/$0.75 per million input/output tokens with an 80% launch discount.
items_flat.summary_zh: Inception Labs發布Mercury 2.5，稱為其最強量產擴散LLM與迄今訓練過最大的此類模型。公司宣稱較Mercury 2智能提升40%、在常見Nvidia GPU上達每秒1,107 token、260K上下文，標價每百萬input/output token 0.20/0.75美元，上市享八折。
items_flat.analysis_en: If the speed and quality claims hold under independent evals, diffusion LLMs become a sharper option for latency-sensitive agents and voice. Those comparisons are the lab’s own, not a third-party leaderboard.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若速度與品質主張經獨立評測成立，擴散LLM會成為低延遲代理與語音的更明確選項。目前比較仍是實驗室自述，非第三方排行。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re releasing Mercury 2.5, our most capable production model yet. It is a significant step up in quality over Mercury 2, with the same low-latency, low-cost serving profile.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布Mercury 2.5，這是迄今最強的量產模型。品質較Mercury 2明顯提升，同時維持低延遲、低成本的服務形態。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches Muse personal agent and publishes a safety-by-design pitch
items_flat.title_zh: Meta推出個人代理Muse並強調安全設計
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent that runs in a dedicated Muse Secure VM with its own browser, connectors and a separate Sentinel gate for outbound actions. It is rolling out in the US on iOS, Android and muse.ai, with glasses support coming, a free tier plus $20 and $100 plans, Stripe Link checkout, and a later Confidential VM where even Meta would lack the key.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta推出個人AI代理Muse，運行於專屬Muse Secure VM，自帶瀏覽器、連接器與獨立Sentinel出站閘道。美國先在iOS、Android與muse.ai上線，眼鏡支援即將到來；有免費層及每月20與100美元方案，結帳走Stripe Link，稍後還有連Meta也拿不到金鑰的Confidential VM。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a consumer-agent surface, not a new open-weight Llama or Muse base-model drop. The unresolved issue is what data the agent retains, under which controls, and whether users will grant the connectors the product needs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是消費代理介面，不是新的開源Llama或Muse基座模型發表。未解問題是代理保留哪些資料、受何種控制，以及使用者會否授予產品所需連接權限。
items_flat.quote: Today, Meta is introducing Muse, a secure, private personal AI agent that proactively helps with people’s goals and suggests ideas.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，Meta推出Muse，一個安全、私密的個人AI代理，主動協助人們達成目標並提出建議。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic pretraining researcher Jacob Coxon quits over self-improving AI fears
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic預訓練研究員Jacob Coxon因自我改進AI風險離職
items_flat.summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic pretraining researcher Jacob Coxon, previously at OpenAI, is leaving the industry, saying labs are racing toward self-improving systems they may not control. Coxon told WSJ aggressive scenarios could be “out of control” by the end of next year; Politico and others quoted follow-up posts that neither Anthropic nor OpenAI is “acting responsibly.” Anthropic had no immediate comment in the WSJ account.
items_flat.summary_zh: 《華爾街日報》報導，曾在OpenAI任職的Anthropic預訓練研究員Jacob Coxon離開產業，稱各實驗室正競相打造可能失控的自我改進系統。他對WSJ表示激進情境可能在明年年底前「失控」；Politico等引述後續貼文稱Anthropic與OpenAI都未「負責任行事」。WSJ記述Anthropic當時未立即評論。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a personnel and safety-politics story, not a model or API change. It lands as Anthropic prepares a public listing narrative; one departure does not prove an internal collapse, but it documents how ‘endgame’ language is now used inside labs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是人事與安全政治新聞，不是模型或API變更。時點落在Anthropic準備上市敘事之際；單一離職不能證明內部崩解，但記錄了實驗室內部已在使用「終局」語言。
items_flat.quote: We’re on track for a lot of the most aggressive of these scenarios where by the end of next year things could be out of control already.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正走向許多最激進情境，明年年底前事態可能已經失控。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands journalism support from J-schools to newsrooms
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將新聞支援從新聞學院擴至新聞室
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is launching a multi-faceted journalism initiative starting with CUNY’s Newmark J-School and Northwestern’s Medill School for the 2026–2027 year, including more than 400 ChatGPT Edu subscriptions for interested graduate students, with a stated path from classrooms into newsrooms.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示將推出多面向新聞計畫，先從CUNY Newmark新聞學院與西北大學Medill學院2026–2027學年開始，向有意願研究生提供逾400個ChatGPT Edu訂閱，並規劃從課堂延伸到新聞室。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is ecosystem access and training, not a model or API change. It may lower newsroom trial friction, but it does not resolve disputes over training data, licensing or compensation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是生態系存取與訓練，不是模型或API變更。或可降低新聞室試用摩擦，但未解決訓練資料、授權或報酬爭議。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI is launching a major, multi-faceted initiative to support the journalism ecosystem with tools, training, partnerships, shared learning, and practical enablement for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 正啟動一項大型、多面向計畫，以工具、訓練、夥伴關係、經驗共享與實務賦能支援新聞生態系，對象含學生、教師、記者與新聞機構。

openai.quote_zh: 我們很高興與 Firmus 合作以擴大全球算力。這些馬來西亞新資料中心將協助我們服務區域與全球對 OpenAI 產品不斷成長的需求。

links.label: Firmus / industry reporting via prior digest

openai.title_en: OpenAI expands journalism support from J-schools to newsrooms
openai.title_zh: OpenAI將新聞支援從新聞學院擴至新聞室
openai.summary_en: OpenAI said it is launching a multi-faceted journalism initiative starting with CUNY’s Newmark J-School and Northwestern’s Medill School for the 2026–2027 year, including more than 400 ChatGPT Edu subscriptions for interested graduate students, with a stated path from classrooms into newsrooms.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI表示將推出多面向新聞計畫，先從CUNY Newmark新聞學院與西北大學Medill學院2026–2027學年開始，向有意願研究生提供逾400個ChatGPT Edu訂閱，並規劃從課堂延伸到新聞室。
openai.analysis_en: This is ecosystem access and training, not a model or API change. It may lower newsroom trial friction, but it does not resolve disputes over training data, licensing or compensation.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是生態系存取與訓練，不是模型或API變更。或可降低新聞室試用摩擦，但未解決訓練資料、授權或報酬爭議。
openai.quote: OpenAI is launching a major, multi-faceted initiative to support the journalism ecosystem with tools, training, partnerships, shared learning, and practical enablement for students, educators, journalists, and news organizations.
openai.quote_zh: OpenAI 正啟動一項大型、多面向計畫，以工具、訓練、夥伴關係、經驗共享與實務賦能支援新聞生態系，對象含學生、教師、記者與新聞機構。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic pretraining researcher Jacob Coxon quits over self-improving AI fears
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic預訓練研究員Jacob Coxon因自我改進AI風險離職
anthropic.summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic pretraining researcher Jacob Coxon, previously at OpenAI, is leaving the industry, saying labs are racing toward self-improving systems they may not control. Coxon told WSJ aggressive scenarios could be “out of control” by the end of next year; Politico and others quoted follow-up posts that neither Anthropic nor OpenAI is “acting responsibly.” Anthropic had no immediate comment in the WSJ account.
anthropic.summary_zh: 《華爾街日報》報導，曾在OpenAI任職的Anthropic預訓練研究員Jacob Coxon離開產業，稱各實驗室正競相打造可能失控的自我改進系統。他對WSJ表示激進情境可能在明年年底前「失控」；Politico等引述後續貼文稱Anthropic與OpenAI都未「負責任行事」。WSJ記述Anthropic當時未立即評論。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is a personnel and safety-politics story, not a model or API change. It lands as Anthropic prepares a public listing narrative; one departure does not prove an internal collapse, but it documents how ‘endgame’ language is now used inside labs.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是人事與安全政治新聞，不是模型或API變更。時點落在Anthropic準備上市敘事之際；單一離職不能證明內部崩解，但記錄了實驗室內部已在使用「終局」語言。
anthropic.quote: We’re on track for a lot of the most aggressive of these scenarios where by the end of next year things could be out of control already.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們正走向許多最激進情境，明年年底前事態可能已經失控。

google.title_en: DeepMind launches AlphaGenome Atlas covering all 9 billion possible human SNVs
google.title_zh: DeepMind推出涵蓋約90億個人類單核苷酸變異的AlphaGenome Atlas
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, a searchable roughly 1-petabyte catalogue of predicted molecular effects for every possible single-nucleotide variant in the human genome—about 9 billion changes. The resource adds an AlphaGenome Variant Impact score that combines AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense, and is free for academic use via a web portal, API and a Google Antigravity skill; commercial Cloud access is planned.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，約1 PB可搜尋目錄，涵蓋人類基因組所有可能單核苷酸變異（約90億處）的分子效應預測。資源新增結合AlphaGenome與AlphaMissense的AVI分數，學術用途可經入口網站、API與Google Antigravity skill免費使用；商業雲端存取規劃中。
google.analysis_en: This is science infrastructure, not a consumer model: last year’s predictor becomes a genome-wide lookup table. Clinical use is not what the lab is authorizing today; independent validation will decide whether AVI scores enter diagnostics.
google.analysis_zh: 這是科學基礎設施而非消費模型：去年的預測器變成全基因組查詢表。實驗室今日並未授權臨床使用；AVI分數能否進入診斷，取決於獨立驗證。
google.quote: Today, we are introducing AlphaGenome Atlas: a platform containing predictions for the effects of 9 billion single-nucleotide variants — every single-letter change possible — in the human genome.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出AlphaGenome Atlas：一個平台，包含人類基因組中90億個單核苷酸變異——每一個可能的單字母改變——的效應預測。

meta.title_en: Meta launches Muse personal agent and publishes a safety-by-design pitch
meta.title_zh: Meta推出個人代理Muse並強調安全設計
meta.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent that runs in a dedicated Muse Secure VM with its own browser, connectors and a separate Sentinel gate for outbound actions. It is rolling out in the US on iOS, Android and muse.ai, with glasses support coming, a free tier plus $20 and $100 plans, Stripe Link checkout, and a later Confidential VM where even Meta would lack the key.
meta.summary_zh: Meta推出個人AI代理Muse，運行於專屬Muse Secure VM，自帶瀏覽器、連接器與獨立Sentinel出站閘道。美國先在iOS、Android與muse.ai上線，眼鏡支援即將到來；有免費層及每月20與100美元方案，結帳走Stripe Link，稍後還有連Meta也拿不到金鑰的Confidential VM。
meta.analysis_en: This is a consumer-agent surface, not a new open-weight Llama or Muse base-model drop. The unresolved issue is what data the agent retains, under which controls, and whether users will grant the connectors the product needs.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是消費代理介面，不是新的開源Llama或Muse基座模型發表。未解問題是代理保留哪些資料、受何種控制，以及使用者會否授予產品所需連接權限。
meta.quote: Today, Meta is introducing Muse, a secure, private personal AI agent that proactively helps with people’s goals and suggests ideas.
meta.quote_zh: 今天，Meta推出Muse，一個安全、私密的個人AI代理，主動協助人們達成目標並提出建議。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral raises €3B Series D at €21B+ valuation, led by Samsung
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral完成三星領投的30億歐元D輪，估值逾210億歐元
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced a €3 billion Series D at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, which it called the largest equity round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after launch. Samsung Electronics led, with EQT-managed Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity as co-leads; Nvidia, ASML, a16z and others participated. Proceeds are slated for frontier research, owned compute and commercial expansion across 20 countries.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral宣布完成30億歐元D輪、投後估值逾210億歐元，並稱這是歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資，距創立僅三年。三星電子領投，EQT管理的Scaleup Europe Fund與PSG Equity共同領投；Nvidia、ASML、a16z等跟投。資金將用於前沿研究、自有算力與20國商業擴張。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The round is a capital-and-sovereignty bet more than a model launch: chip suppliers now sit on both sides of Mistral’s cap table. Whether the money produces a competitive open-weight frontier model is still unproven.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此輪更像資本與主權押注，而非模型發表：晶片供應商已同時站在Mistral股權兩側。資金能否換來具競爭力的開源權重前沿模型，仍未驗證。
frontier_other.quote: Mistral today announced that it has raised €3 billion in a Series D funding round at a post-money valuation of more than €21 billion, the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company, three years after the company's launch.
frontier_other.quote_zh: Mistral今日宣布完成30億歐元D輪融資，投後估值逾210億歐元，為歐洲科技公司有史以來最大股權融資，距公司創立僅三年。

frontier_other.title_en: Inception Labs releases Mercury 2.5 diffusion LLM at 1,107 tok/s
frontier_other.title_zh: Inception Labs發布每秒1,107 token的擴散LLM Mercury 2.5
frontier_other.summary_en: Inception Labs released Mercury 2.5, calling it its most capable production diffusion LLM and the largest such model it has trained. The company claims a 40% intelligence lift over Mercury 2, 1,107 tokens per second on widely available Nvidia GPUs, a 260K context window, and list pricing of $0.20/$0.75 per million input/output tokens with an 80% launch discount.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Inception Labs發布Mercury 2.5，稱為其最強量產擴散LLM與迄今訓練過最大的此類模型。公司宣稱較Mercury 2智能提升40%、在常見Nvidia GPU上達每秒1,107 token、260K上下文，標價每百萬input/output token 0.20/0.75美元，上市享八折。
frontier_other.analysis_en: If the speed and quality claims hold under independent evals, diffusion LLMs become a sharper option for latency-sensitive agents and voice. Those comparisons are the lab’s own, not a third-party leaderboard.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 若速度與品質主張經獨立評測成立，擴散LLM會成為低延遲代理與語音的更明確選項。目前比較仍是實驗室自述，非第三方排行。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re releasing Mercury 2.5, our most capable production model yet. It is a significant step up in quality over Mercury 2, with the same low-latency, low-cost serving profile.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天我們發布Mercury 2.5，這是迄今最強的量產模型。品質較Mercury 2明顯提升，同時維持低延遲、低成本的服務形態。

brief_en: OpenAI published an agent-produced Navier–Stokes blowup proof with Lean; Mistral closed a €3B Series D led by Samsung; DeepMind shipped AlphaGenome Atlas; OpenAI rolled Images 2.5 and Astra in Work/Codex; Meta launched Muse. An Anthropic pretraining researcher quit over self-improving-AI fears.
brief_zh: OpenAI公布代理產出的Navier–Stokes爆破證明與Lean形式化；Mistral完成三星領投的30億歐元D輪；DeepMind上線AlphaGenome Atlas；OpenAI推出Images 2.5並在Work/Codex全面開放Astra；Meta推出Muse。Anthropic預訓練研究員因自我改進AI風險離職。
